title: Coursebook error envelope v2
description: Every failure the backend reports, in HTTP or inside an RPC response, uses this object. The catalog below is the single authority for codes, categories, retryability and status mapping; coursebook.contracts reads it rather than duplicating it. v2 adds DELETE_SCOPE_STALE for the previewed-scope deletion protocol.

message.description: Operator-readable, already localized for the caller. Never contains reference answers, keys or secrets.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the same request may succeed. A non-retryable error must not be retried automatically.

details.description: Structured, non-sensitive context (field name, failing rule, rejected path).

current_revision.description: Present on conflict responses so the client can reconcile without a second read.

VALIDATION_FAILED.summary: Request or payload violates the frozen contract.

NOT_FOUND.summary: Referenced record does not exist for this scope.

CONTRACT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.summary: Caller and backend disagree on a contract version.

STALE_REVISION.summary: Expected revision is not current; caller must reconcile against current_revision.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.summary: Idempotency key was reused with a different payload hash.

BINDING_NOT_ACTIVE.summary: Session binding is paused, detached, branched or orphaned; reconcile before submitting.

CHECK_STALE.summary: The open check has been superseded; no attempt was created.

GRADER_UNAVAILABLE.summary: Grading could not finish. The answer is saved; no progress changed.

HOST_UNAVAILABLE.summary: The Hermes host (gateway, auxiliary model, media provider) is unavailable.

TOPOLOGY_UNSUPPORTED.summary: Desktop and backend do not share a filesystem/authority topology; the operation is refused rather than faked.

PACK_REJECTED.summary: Pack failed schema, bounds, hash, MIME or active-content validation. Nothing was adopted.

POLICY_VIOLATION.summary: Untrusted content attempted to change policy, tools, rubrics, state, reminders or exports.

JOB_NOT_CANCELLABLE.summary: Job is already terminal or cancelling.

JOB_STATE_INVALID.summary: Requested job transition is not in the frozen job state machine.

NOT_IMPLEMENTED.summary: Contract method is frozen but its handler is not implemented in this build.

INTERNAL_ERROR.summary: Unexpected backend failure. Details are logged, not returned verbatim.

DELETE_SCOPE_STALE.summary: The deletion data scope changed after it was previewed; re-preview before deleting. Nothing was deleted.
